title: Lean lab: force a lean, end it safely, take over a leaning pawn (DPC 0.9.176-dev5)
intro: lean-lab-1 found the lean spots but couldn't use them (the spot's interaction object sits on the gimmick, not as a component). Fixed; same test again. SAVE FIRST. Press End to start; most steps run by themselves.

steps.text: 1/8 In the tavern (or anywhere with pawns near walls), playing the Arisen, pawns standing near you. SAVE FIRST. Press End; the next steps run by themselves.
2/8 (automatic) Looking for lean spots near your main pawn.
3/8 (automatic) Making your main pawn lean on the nearest spot. Watch him.
4/8 (automatic) Asking him to stop leaning the game's way (abort), without you playing him.
6/8 (automatic) Taking control of him while he leans: DPC should make him stand up first, then hand him to you.
7/8 You play him now (if the take-over worked). Walk around: can he move? End.
8/8 Back to the Arisen. Tell Claude: did he lean in step 3, stand up in step 4, and could you move him in step 7? End.

probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.state.active and ('playing '..tostring(D.state.pawn_name)) or 'Arisen') or ''
probes.pawns: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local pm=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.PawnManager'); local l=pm and pm:call('get_PawnCharacterList'); if not (D and l) then return '' end; local t={}; for i=0,l:call('get_Count')-1 do local c=l:call('get_Item',i); local n='?'; pcall(function() n=tostring(c:call('get_ActionManager'):get_field('Fsm'):call('getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)',0)) end); t[#t+1]=i..':'..(D.R.busy_interact(c) and 'IN INTERACTION ' or '')..n end; return table.concat(t,' / ')
probes.spots: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.lean_spots) or ''
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
